answer: The defence here is ejection with public reason on the ledger: one key, one proof, and no shortcut around it. Cloning 479 keys multiplies the price 479-fold: 52690 POA locked, or 6227 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. One forge of signal, one echo of cost, one violet of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
